findings.entity: jar contents vs. small glass cup (first pour)
findings.description: The hand-held cup visibly contains only green olives (00:00.000-00:01.250, full-res frames 1 and 3), and the falling stream is green, yet a dark purple/black olive appears on the jar floor at 00:00.500 and by 00:01.750 roughly half of the ~15 olives in the jar are dark purple/black. Dark olives arrive from a source that held only green olives.

The small cup holds roughly 8-10 olives at 00:00, but continuous pouring from 00:00.5 to 00:03.5 deposits ~25 olives in the jar while the cup still looks full of green olives through ~00:02.75. The amount arriving exceeds what the source could hold, with no visible refill during this pour.

findings.entity: small glass cup contents after scooping from steel bowl
findings.description: The cup is refilled from the steel bowl, which contained only green olives (plus brown nut-like items revealed after the scoop). At 00:05.75-00:06.0 the cup shows only green olives, but by 00:06.75-00:07.5 several dark purple olives are in the cup and pour into the jar. No dark olives were ever in the steel bowl and none was added to the cup.

The second cupful holds about 8-10 olives, yet the jar goes from ~25 olives (00:04) to ~45 olives (00:08.75-00:09.0), and the added olives are mostly dark although the scoop came from a bowl of green olives. The increase exceeds the visible source.

Right after the scoop (00:05.25) the steel bowl holds about 2 green olives plus brown items. By 00:09.0-00:09.75 it shows about 5 green olives, with nothing visibly added. The camera angle changed in between, so this may be a perspective effect.
